newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: V&N Waermetechnik 9-month pretax off 19 pct.
newsitem.headline: V&N Waermetechnik 9-month pretax off 19 pct.

text.p: Austrian heating equipment maker Vogel & Noot Waermetechnik AG said on Wednesday pre-tax profit in the first nine months of the year fell 18.7 percent to 77.2 million schillings.
Sales climbed to 1.367 billion schillings from 1.259 billion in the year-ago three quarters, while cash flow was marginally higher at 212.4 million schillings.
V & N said business developed in line with company expectations in the first three quarters and that the earnings reflect the pressure on prices.
V & N Waermetechnik is majority owned by Vogel & Noot Holding AG. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12 253
